# Paint Studio

> Agent-friendly animation studio with a shared TypeScript core, CLI renderer (PNG/GIF), and black/yellow browser editor.

## Links

- Repo: https://github.com/Mazin7d4/PaintWebApp
- Live demo: https://mazin7d4.github.io/PaintWebApp/
- Agent guide: AGENTS.md
- Schema: schemas/paint-project.schema.json
- Examples: examples/*.paint.json

## CLI

```
npx paint-studio create project.paint.json --style neon
npx paint-studio check project.paint.json
npx paint-studio objects project.paint.json --time 0
npx paint-studio edit project.paint.json --op '{"op":"setKeyframe","id":"ball","t":500,"transform":{"y":300},"easing":"easeOutBounce"}'
npx paint-studio render project.paint.json -o out.gif
npx paint-studio render project.paint.json -o frames --format png-sequence
npx paint-studio export-hyperframes project.paint.json -o composition.html
```

## Style presets

flat-vector | inked-cartoon | pixel-art | painterly | neon

## Object types

stroke (brush + pressure points, writeOnMs) | shape | text | particles

## Edit ops

addLayer | removeLayer | setLayer | moveLayer | addObject | removeObject | duplicateObject | updateObject | moveObject | setTransform | translate | setKeyframe | removeKeyframe | moveKeyframe | clearKeyframes | setProject | addFrame | removeFrame | setFrame
Same JSON ops are used by `paint-studio edit`, the MCP tool `paint_edit_project`, and `window.paintStudio.apply()`. Batches are atomic.

## MCP tools

paint_create_project | paint_check_project | paint_generate_animation | paint_edit_project | paint_list_objects | paint_render

## Browser

window.paintStudio.help() lists the API: apply, addObject, setTransform, setKeyframe, addLayer, select, setTime, play, exportGif, exportWebm, exportSpriteSheet, exportPngSequence, worldToScreen, undo, redo.
